guard/30430.htm.text: Sentinel Trionell: May the twinkle of starlight become a beautiful song that wholly fills your soul. I am Trionell, one of the sentinels who guard the Elven Forest. This place is the Neutral Zone which was made when the Elves and Dark Elves signed a peace agreement.

links.text: See the Lord and get the tax rate information.

guard/30430-1.htm.text: Sentinel Trionell: The Neutral Zone begins right after crossing this bridge. After the war between the Elves and Dark Elves, the area was designated as a Neutral Zone to prevent conflict. It has played its role as a buffer zone for a long time.
